title: Permission denied, again
briefing: The release bot can't run the deploy script:
You can read it. Something stops it from running.
tips: `ls -l` shows the rwx bits. No x means it can't execute.
objective: Make ~/app/release.sh runnable and run it (it writes ~/app/released.txt when it works).
hints: The error is about the file itself. Inspect its permissions with `ls -l app/release.sh`.
It has no execute bit. `chmod +x app/release.sh` adds it.
explanation: A script needs the execute bit to run as ./script.sh — reading it isn't enough. `chmod +x` grants it. (`bash script.sh` only needs read, because bash reads the file itself, but a cron job that calls ./script.sh still needs x.) You've mastered permissions.
